activeStep.kidMeaningRu: Теперь надо проверить новую идею по-настоящему и посмотреть, сломается ли она.
activeStep.whyNow: RUN_059 has already produced a concrete next hypothesis and gameplay transfer map, but RUN_074 is still a candidate and has not passed preregistered hidden confirmation tests.

vnoPriority.meaning: These scores measure progress through the VNO evidence process, not percentage truth of a real-world law.

nextAction.kidMeaningRu: Сначала заранее запиши правила проверки. Потом дай другой независимой программе те же правила и спрячь от неё ответы. После этого специально ломай порядок изменений, теряй их, дублируй и порть — и смотри, сможет ли мир всё равно восстановиться правильно.
technical: Freeze RUN_074 per-system identity, ordering, exactness, storage/network benefit and failure thresholds before holdout.
Build a clean-room reconstruction implementation from the written specification without copying the source algorithm.
Generate hidden change histories independently from the implementation under test.
Run delta reorder, duplicate, drop, corruption, stable-ID collision, generator-version and dense-edit attacks.
Require exact authoritative reconstruction for every applicable gameplay system before promotion.
Record negative results and do not lower thresholds after holdout.

loopRule: When step 4-6 evidence is complete, select the strongest surviving result or most useful refutation and return to step 1. Do not mark RUN_074 confirmed merely because it is the current candidate.
